title: Animated micro-onboarding moments and asset pack for API/SDK first-run
creator: Lena Brooks
description: Create an asset pack of micro-animations, still screens, and annotated screenshots for the API/SDK Quickstart docs. Focused scope: first-run flows that cover auth (API key creation and rotation), ephemeral keys for local dev, streaming responses (skeleton + incremental tokens), and the tool-calling modal example. Deliverables must be export-ready for web docs and in-app SDK overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Eight micro-animations exported as Lottie JSON and MP4 demos (looping where appropriate)
12 annotated PNG screenshots (2x) demonstrating UI states: key creation, key copy, ephemeral key toast, streaming start/end, tool-call modal open/execute, retry after failure
Figma file with components, tokens, and named export frames (link in attachments)
Accessibility checklist met: motion-safe variants, reduced-motion PNG fallbacks, minimum 4.5:1 contrast for overlays
Developer handoff notes included: asset filenames, recommended HTML embed snippets, and CDN paths
design_notes:
Primary goal is micro-interactions that make onboarding feel immediate without being noisy. Decisions made in the first pass:
- Use Lottie for the longer, brandful animations (key creation, streaming typing bar) and SVG/CSS for small state transitions (copy toast, small toggles).
- Provide MP4 and GIF fallbacks for legacy docs/CDNs that don't support Lottie.
- Streaming visual: incremental token highlights + thin top progress shimmer; ensure it degrades to a single skeleton line for reduced-motion.
- Tool-calling flow: modal open -> select tool -> confirm -> show tool output card; animate only the modal and the response card to reduce perceived latency.
- Auth flow: introduce an ephemeral key microcopy and rotate affordance; animate the rotate icon with a subtle spin (200ms) and an undo affordance for accidental rotation.
- Use atomic component tokens from global styles (colors, radii, spacing); export tokens used in README for engineers.
deliverables: 8 Lottie JSONs (named: key-create, key-copy-toast, ephemeral-key-toast, streaming-start, streaming-token-highlight, tool-modal-open, tool-exec-success, rotate-key-spin)
8 MP4 demo clips (5-10s each) and 8 GIF fallbacks
12 PNG annotated screenshots (2x) with redlines in Figma
Figma source file (components + tokens), handoff page with usage notes
README.md with embed snippets and CDN paths
attachments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489 - PR with initial screenshots and markdown
